_hypothesis_disclaimer: This mapping is a REVIEWABLE HYPOTHESIS, not ground truth. Every shape->site/tag entry is the curator's best guess at where a shape is plausibly expressed in a public corpus; it has not been validated against the frozen Phase-0 rubric. Concordance between two independent agent labelers (tools/goa/concordance_gate.py) is the actual validation signal. A shape whose sampled candidates are mostly rejected at labeling should have its allowlist revisited here, not silently backfilled with more candidates from the same tags.
